p4.description1: Converts Scratch projects into HTML files, zip archives, or executable programs for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
p4.description2: If you just want an easy way to embed a project into your website, you may be interested in {embedding}.
p4.description3: Report bugs, give feedback, and suggest ideas {onScratch} or {onGitHub}.
p4.disclaimer: This site is not affiliated with Scratch, the Scratch Team, or the Scratch Foundation.
p4.networkError: Couldn't download {url}. Make sure you're connected to the internet and try disabling any browser extensions.
p4.outdated: This version of the packager appears to be outdated. Please refresh and try again.
p4.cannotAccessProject: Can't access project token. This usually means the project is unshared, never existed, the ID is invalid, or your network is blocking turbowarp.org.
p4.cannotAccessProjectCaching: If the project was shared recently, it may take a few minutes for this message to go away.
p4.unknownImportError: Something went wrong. Please refresh and try again.

select.selectHelp: Select the project you want to package by copying and pasting the Scratch project link or using one of the other modes. If you use a project you didn't make, make sure to credit the creator.
select.unsharedProjects: Unshared projects are no longer accessible using their project ID due to Scratch API changes.
select.unsharedProjectsWorkaround: Instead, you can either share the project or save the project to your computer (File > Save to your computer) and load the file in the packager. Files generated by the packager are fully self contained and not affected by these changes.
select.unsharedProjectsMore: For more information and workarounds, visit: {link}

options.storedWarning: Note: This project has settings stored in it, which may override these settings.
options.stretch: Stretch stage to fill screen without changing actual size (experimental)
options.dynamicResize: Dynamically resize size to match window size (experimental)
options.username: Username (each "#" gets replaced with a random number)
options.customUsernameWarning: Be careful when changing the default username as it can cause connections to the default cloud variable server to be blocked. Only the default username is guaranteed to work.
options.autoplay: Start project automatically instead of showing a big green flag
options.autoplayHint: Note: Many browsers will not allow websites to automatically play sound, so sounds might not play until the user interacts with the project.
options.showFlag: Show green flag button in controls
options.showStop: Show stop sign button in controls
options.accentColor: Accent color (active/hovered controls, ask prompt, context menus)
options.controlsHelp: If all controls are disabled, the controls bar is removed entirely. If only fullscreen is enabled, it will always be located in the top left corner, not in the controls header.
options.foregroundColor: Foreground color (progress bar, some icons, some text)
options.cursorHelp: Images up to 32x32 work best. Larger images may not work reliably.
options.noCloudVariables: This project does not contain cloud variables.
options.cloudVariables-ws-help: "Connect to cloud variable server" syncs variables with other users.
options.cloudVariables-local-help: "Store in local storage" stores variables on each user's computer and restores them when the project is opened. If a user has multiple windows/tabs of the project open, changes will sync between those windows.
options.cloudVariables-ignore-help: "Ignore" treats cloud variables like normal variables.
options.cloudVariables-custom-help: "Advanced" uses a different mode for each variable, so some variables can sync with other users but others can be stored locally, for example.
options.advancedSummary: You probably don't want to change these. (Click to open)
options.specialCloudBehaviors: Special cloud variable behaviors like HTMLifier
options.unsafeCloudBehaviorsWarning: Unsafe cloud behaviors allows the packaged project to execute arbitrary code outside of the "sandbox" that projects are typically executed in. Depending on the environment you're packaging for, this grants projects full control over your computer, including the ability to install viruses. If you do not trust the project you're packaging, please turn off this option.
options.implicitCloudHint: Tip: Any variable with a name starting with "{cloud}" will be converted to a cloud variable regardless of whether it was marked as one.
options.projectIdHelp: Project ID is used when connecting to a cloud variable server and storing local cloud variables. It can contain more than just numbers.
options.packagedRuntime: Remove raw asset data after loading to save RAM
options.customExtensionsSecurity: Custom extensions are always run unsandboxed in the packager. Depending on the environment you're packaging for, this grants extensions full control over your computer, including the ability to install viruses. Don't use extensions you don't trust.
options.bakeExtensions: Try to embed cached copy of custom extensions instead of downloading them each time the project is run
options.customCSS: Custom CSS (Don't change if you don't know what you're doing!)
options.customJS: Custom JS (Don't change if you don't know what you're doing!)
options.customCSP: Custom CSP (This can make your project less secure!!)
options.zip-one-asset: Zip, combine assets into single file (not recommended)
options.otherEnvironmentsHelp: Most new projects should use the options listed above instead.
options.packageNameHelp: Package name should be a unique name used only by your application. The same project should always have the same package name.
options.versionHelp: Updating the version is completely optional and doesn't affect your project's behavior. It may appear in places like about screens depending on the environment. Should be formatted as X.Y.Z.
options.maxTextureDimension: Increase max vector costume resolution to make large costumes look better. May increase memory use and cause crashes.
options.steamworksMacWarning: Warning: macOS games published on Steam need to be notarized by Apple, which the packager doesn't support. You can still test your game on a Mac, but you won't be able to publish it for macOS yet.
options.steamworksDocumentation: See the extension's documentation for more details.
options.steamworksUnavailable: To enable the Steamworks extension, you must use one of these environments:
options.steamworksAvailable: This project is using the Steamworks extension. You can find your game's App ID in Steamworks, or use {n} for testing with the Steamworks demo game.
options.steamworksOnError: If there is an error initializing Steamworks
options.confirmImportUnsafe: These settings use advanced features such as custom JS that run unknown and possibly malicious code on your computer. Only import this file if you trust the person who created it. If you're not sure what this means, you probably shouldn't import these settings.

downloads.useWorkaround: Click here if download link doesn't work

reset.confirm: Are you sure you want to reset these settings? This cannot be undone.
reset.confirmAll: Are you sure you want to reset ALL settings? This cannot be undone.

import.description: This may take a while if the project is large.
